node.title: M31 rank-seven zero-excess two-block incidence router
node.statement: In the M31 Q=147595 rank-seven normalized-label residual, every zero-excess proper-G member has planted/external support sizes q and 72428-q, and two distinct members have total support intersection at most 4980. Consequently the complete q<=4980 tail has at most 40 members, the q>=67448 tail has at most 7, and any violating proper mass contains at least 2157882 distinct locators with 4981<=q<=67447. Its mean q satisfies an exact quadratic confinement, in particular 23945<mean(q)<24860.
node.notes: Exact local route reduction only. It proves no middle-band upper bound, Q=147595 payment, v4 atom, M31 row closure, higher-rank theorem, MCA result, or Prize endpoint movement.
